query: UPDATE tracker_connections SET name=$3,base_url=$4,token=$5,enabled=$6,projects=$7,people_mapping=$9,generation=$10,options=$11,checkpoint=$8,next_run_at=clock_timestamp(),status='pending',last_error='',push_error=NULL,remote_user_id=CASE WHEN base_url=$4 AND token=$5 THEN remote_user_id END,incremental_supported=true WHERE workspace_id=$1 AND id=$2
